scope: Whole native camera-space spectra; not 3D fusion, automatic plant identity or calibrated reflectance.
source_format: ENVI data type12, byte order0, header offset0, BIL uint16 little endian [2127,224,columns]. FX10columns1024; FX17columns640.

normalization.W_D_meaning: Existing per-band, per-detector-column median profiles over the recorded reviewed ROIs.
normalization.reference_support: Only intersecting reviewed white and dark detector columns. No extrapolation.
normalization.reference_status: White board identity confirmed, spectral reflectance unknown. Exposure fixed by user report. Tail dark is assumed; shutter closure unconfirmed. Q and Q0 are sensitivity scenarios, not reflectance.
normalization.Q_and_Q0_same_eligibility: (band_flags &31)==0, even though Q0 does not subtract D.
normalization.invalid_normalized_values: NaN/null explicitly; never zero-fill or replace with raw DN.
normalization.finite_values: Keep finite negative and above-one Q/Q0; display scaling must not silently alter exported values.
normalization.float_precision: Existing arrays use float32. JavaScript arithmetic may differ at final low bits unless Math.fround is used for float32 numerator, denominator and result. Raw uint16 DN must remain exact.

band_quality_flags.2: sample_suspected_clipping: DN>=65520; configured exploratory ceiling, not proven ADC bit depth
band_quality_flags.4: reference_suspected_clipping: any white/dark reference source value>=65520 at this band,column
band_quality_flags.32: low_signal_above_dark_advisory: DN-D<=max(32,3*dark_MAD_sigma); advisory for Q but excludes required index bands

indices.fx17_reason: Recorded935.61-1720.23nm cannot supply the visible/red bands required by these descriptors. No crosscamera band mixing/substitution.
indices.reference_scan_line_exclusion: Exclude every source line inside configured white or dark line interval, regardless of detector column.
indices.denominator_sign: NDVI/NDRE/GNDVI/PRI sums and PSRIQ750 must exceed0.01. SIPI absolute(Q800-Q680) must exceed0.01.
indices.output_policy: Any nonzero index flag means NaN/null. Descriptors apply to a pixel signal; clicking background does not make it plant physiology.

display.band_preview: 8bit contrast-windowed JPEG visualization only; JPEG introduces display intensity approximation. Click spectrum must use lossless row data, never reverse-map display gray to raw DN.
display.complete_native_pixel_access: All2127recorded lines and all detector columns can return raw224-band DN, including background, reference and clipped/zero observations.

source_identity.existing_extraction_identity_check: size,mtime_ns,inode before/after; explicitly weaker than full content SHA256
source_identity.audit_hashes: Fresh header SHA256 and representative exact native row fingerprints; not a full-cube hash.
source_identity.recommended_full_export_hash: Increment SHA256 with each original BIL row bytes before transpose/delta while exporting in line order; this gives exact source full-content hash without a second I/O pass.

recommended_row_encoding.delta: For each band, preserve column0; for column c>0 store (DN[c,b]-DN[c-1,b]) modulo65536.
recommended_row_encoding.shuffle: Flatten column-major pixel records in C order (column*224+band). Emit all low bytes then all high bytes.
recommended_row_encoding.decode: Decompress; for i=0..columns*224-1 let delta=bytes[i]|(bytes[N+i]<<8). DN[i]=(delta+(i>=224?DN[i-224]:0))&65535.
recommended_row_encoding.roundtrip_scope: All sampled rows verified bit-exact. Production export should verify every row roundtrip or randomized full rows plus full source hash.
